_comment: Copy to prices.json to put dollars in the report. Optional: every table
reports tokens and bytes regardless, and an unset rate prints '--', which
Nothing here is filled in for you on purpose. Your rates differ from ours by
region, by edition, and by whatever committed-use discount you negotiated,
and a plausible-looking wrong number in a cost-per-correct-answer column is
worse than an empty one. Look them up, then record where and when below --
'source' and 'verified' are printed under the cost table, so a reader can
tell a dated list price from an invention.
bq_per_tib_usd:      BigQuery on-demand analysis, per TiB billed.
Skip it if you are on capacity/slots -- this harness
measures bytes, which do not price a reservation.
input_per_mtok_usd:  Gemini prompt tokens, per million. Dominates: tool
output_per_mtok_usd: Gemini output tokens, per million. Under 1% of total
tokens in every arm measured here.
